full_page.content:
1947, February 11
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
POSTCARD
Feast of the Apparition of Mary our Immaculate Mother.
February 11th 1947
God bless you Alice O'Brien -- you and yours.
Many thanks for kind favor of Febr. 6th -- duly Rec'd and noted.
Glad to know that things seem brightening up.
Thanks be to God for all His mercies
Am herewith inclosing a few "jubilee cards."
Thanks be to God for such privileges as have been mine these fifty years.
Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
(picture side of card has following added :) (picture of Saint Felix Capuchin Friary Huntington, Ind. )
Clerical Novitiate (rear) -- looking toward City 12 miles down on the Wabash River. We have 18 novices -- room for 40. Pray
Original in possession of : Alice O'Brien 320 No. Second St. Stillwater, Minn. 55082
